algorithm: two-stream Neural Dynamic Policy (NDP) trajectory regression (L1 loss): pretrained on human-video-retargeted trajectories, fine-tuned on real teleoperated demonstrations; R3M visual encoder
success_criterion: binary-judged — Binary 0-1 real-robot task success per trial, split train (seen) vs test (held-out); judged against the task description in Sec. 5 ("goal is to pickup an object"), no threshold in meters/seconds.
headline_metric: binary task success rate, train (seen) vs. test (held-out objects)
headline_value: Table 1: Pick 0.83/0.77 (VideoDex) vs. BC-NDP 0.64/0.38, BC-Open 0.50/0.44, BC-RNN 0.56/0.31; Place 0.89/0.80 vs. BC-NDP 0.70/0.35
human_data: EpicKitchens (curated via existing action annotations; 350-2500 clips per task, 5-10s each)
note_gaps: the hand-retargeting network (borrowed from Robotic Telekinesis) is never ablated in isolation; test-eval trial counts per cell are not stated as integers, only success fractions with std. dev.
retargeting_objective: hand poses mapped via a distilled MLP replicating a Robotic-Telekinesis-style fingertip/palm keypoint-vector energy function; wrist trajectory computed via a PnP + monocular SLAM + heuristic gravity-alignment + workspace-rescaling pipeline, both applied offline to build pretraining trajectories, not run online at deployment
